note: same shape as the file the training run will write, every figure is null until it is measured
limits: Until the trained model lands, both scores on the result page come from the same physics measurements, so they are equal.
Few lunar analog sites exist, so any Moon result rests on a handful of sites.
Only about 9% of the pixels in the lunar 5 m elevation data are measured. The rest are filled in, and are smoother than the real ground.
Earth is scored from 30 m elevation data. Features smaller than that are invisible to the model.
The bars add up before the score is squashed to 0 to 100, so a bar's length is not a number of score points.
No Earth site reproduces lunar gravity, vacuum or radiation. The score is about terrain and light, nothing else.
